telemetry_info.screen.description:
Collecting this data helps us improve Minecraft by guiding us in directions that are relevant to our jogadores.
You can also send in additional comentários to ajuda us keep improving Minecraft.
telemetry_info.screen.title: Telemetry Data Collection
telemetry.event.advancement_made.descrip: Understanding the context behind receiving an advancement can ajuda us better understand and improve the progression of the game.
telemetry.event.advancement_made.title: Advancement Made
telemetry.event.game_load_times.descript: This event can ajuda us figure out where startup desempenho melhorias are needed by measuring the execution times of the startup phases.
telemetry.event.game_load_times.title: Game Carregar Times
telemetry.event.graphics_capabilities.de: This event informs us of the capabilities of the gráficos device used to play the game.
telemetry.event.p2p_connection.descripti: This event helps us understand the reliability and desempenho of peer-to-peer connections between jogadores. It records whether the conexão was successful, the type of Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE, the protocol we use to establish peer-to-peer connections) candidate used, and how long it took to establish the conexão.
telemetry.event.p2p_connection.title: Peer-to-peer Conexão
telemetry.event.performance_metrics.desc:
Knowing the overall desempenho perfil of Minecraft helps us tune and optimize the game for a wide alcance of machine specifications and operating systems.
Game version is included to ajuda us compare the desempenho perfil for novo versions of Minecraft.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It's important for us to understand how long it takes to join a mundo, and how that changes over tempo. For example, when we adicionar novo features or do larger technical changes, we need to see what impact that had on carregar times.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.title: Mundo Carregar Times
telemetry.event.world_loaded.description:
Knowing how jogadores play Minecraft (such as Modo de Jogo, client or servidor modded, and game version) allows us to focus game updates to improve the areas that jogadores care about most.
The Mundo Loaded event is paired with the Mundo Unloaded event to calculate how long the play session has lasted.
telemetry.event.world_loaded.title: Mundo Loaded
telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
This event is paired with the Mundo Loaded event to calculate how long the mundo session has lasted.
The duration (in seconds and ticks) is measured when a mundo session has ended (quitting to título, disconnecting from a servidor).
telemetry.event.world_unloaded.title: Mundo Unloaded
